digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI, ch. 3

teaser.en: Its fruits have two long wings and spin to the ground like helicopter blades.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake yana mabawa mawili marefu na huzunguka yakishuka chini kama rafu za helikopta.

summary.en: Mchusa is a pale-barked, soft-wooded tree of the dry coast whose fruits carry two long wings. Pakia uses it to illustrate the Digo word for fruit wings.
summary.sw: Mchusa ni mti wa pwani kavu wenye gome jeupe-jeupe na mbao laini, ambao matunda yake yana mabawa mawili marefu. Pakia anautumia kuonyesha neno la Kidigo la mabawa ya matunda.

about.en: Mchusa is a deciduous tree, usually 10 to 20 metres tall, with smooth, pale grey to silvery bark and soft, light wood. The large leaves are heart-shaped to three-lobed, crowded towards the ends of the branches. It flowers when leafless, producing clusters of tiny greenish flowers. The fruit is its best-known feature: a small nut carrying two long, narrow, papery wings. When it falls it spins like a helicopter rotor and can travel some distance on the wind.
about.sw: Mchusa ni mti unaopukutisha majani, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa mita 10 hadi 20, gome lake laini la kijivu hafifu hadi la rangi ya fedha, na mbao laini na nyepesi. Majani yake makubwa yana umbo la moyo hadi kuwa na pembe tatu, na yamesongamana kuelekea ncha za matawi. Huchanua ukiwa hauna majani, ukitoa vishada vya maua madogo sana ya rangi ya kijani-kijani. Tunda ndilo sifa yake inayojulikana zaidi: kokwa ndogo yenye mabawa mawili marefu, membamba kama karatasi. Linapoanguka huzunguka kama rafu za helikopta na linaweza kusafiri umbali fulani likipeperushwa na upepo.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal forest, woodland and bushland, often on coral rag and rocky ground. It is found in dry tropical regions around the world.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya pwani, mapori na nyika ya vichaka, mara nyingi kwenye ardhi ya matumbawe na yenye mawe. Hupatikana katika maeneo makavu ya tropiki duniani kote.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. Elsewhere in its range the light, soft wood is carved into items such as bowls and small canoes.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Kwingineko katika eneo unakopatikana, mbao zake nyepesi na laini huchongwa kutengeneza vitu kama bakuli na mitumbwi midogo.

culture.en: Pakia illustrates the winged fruit of *Gyrocarpus americanus* in his chapter on plant parts (Fig. 3.5). The Digo call such winged structures *mapha*, 'wings', as also in *Combretum schumannii* (*mkongolo*).
culture.sw: Pakia anaonyesha kwa mchoro tunda lenye mabawa la *Gyrocarpus americanus* katika sura yake kuhusu sehemu za mimea (Mchoro 3.5). Wadigo huviita viungo hivyo vyenye mabawa *mapha*, 'mabawa', kama ilivyo pia kwa *Combretum schumannii* (*mkongolo*).

names.en: Digo: *mchusa*. Pakia records it only for Digo and gives no meaning. In English it is called the helicopter tree or propeller tree, after its fruit.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mchusa*. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu na hatoi maana yake. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *helicopter tree* au *propeller tree*, kutokana na tunda lake.

reason.en: Combretum schumannii, Pakia's other example of winged fruits
reason.sw: Combretum schumannii (mgongolo), mfano mwingine wa Pakia wa matunda yenye mabawa

reason.en: African star-chestnut, another pale-barked tree of the dry bush
reason.sw: Mgoza, mti mwingine wa nyika kavu wenye gome jeupe-jeupe

reason.en: Kapok, another soft-wooded tree illustrated in the same figure
reason.sw: Msufi, mti mwingine wa mbao laini unaoonyeshwa katika mchoro huo huo

reason.en: Baobab, another tree of dry coastal bush
reason.sw: Mbuyu, mti mwingine wa nyika kavu ya pwani

definition.en: The wings on winged fruits. Pakia could not confirm the term because these trees were uncommon in some study areas.
definition.sw: Mabawa ya matunda yenye mabawa. Pakia hakuweza kulithibitisha neno hili kwa sababu miti hii haikuwa ya kawaida katika baadhi ya maeneo ya utafiti.
